Question: Consider the graphs of \((1)\) \(y=x^2-\dfrac12x+2\) and \((2)\) \(y=x^2+\dfrac12x+2\) on the same set of axes. These parabolas have exactly the same shape. Then:

Choices.B: the graph of \((1)\) is lower than the graph of \((2).\)
Choices.C:
the graph of \((1)\) is to the left of the graph of
\((2).\)
Choices.D:
the graph of \((1)\) is to the right of the
graph of \((2).\)
Choices.E: the graph of \((1)\) is higher than the graph of \((2).\)
